author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
YEAHHH! Bucky and Yelena are coming to Avengers Campus on November 27.
Bucky and Yelena will return in Avengers: Doomsday. In theaters everywhere December 18. 

Beginning on November 27, more Super Heroes will assemble for Heroic Encounters at Disney California Adventure park. For the first time, guests can meet Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova at Avengers Campus. The pair made an impression as the deadpan duo in Thunderbolts, combining Bucky’s tactical precision and super-soldier strength with Yelena’s stealth, agility, and Black Widow training. Now, the duo will make their way to Avengers Campus for a limited time.

author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
EPCOT Holiday Storytellers Narrated By Jordan Fisher
Experience the magic of the holidays at EPCOT like never before! 🌍✨ Gather your family, sit back and relax as we present the complete performances and holiday tales from EPCOT Holiday Storytellers around the World Showcase during the EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays.

With special narration by Jordan Fisher, who guides viewers on a festive journey around the world, introducing each storyteller and connecting the holiday traditions that bring these celebrations to life. From festive musical traditions in Canada and Mexico to heartwarming stories from Italy, Norway and beyond, immerse yourself in the sights, sounds, and celebrations that make EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays unforgettable.

Get wrapped up in the EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays at Walt Disney World - November 27 through December 30, 2026.

👉 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell for more Disney Parks content, full shows, and behind-the-scenes content!

💬 Share your favorite storyteller or tradition in the comments—we’d love to hear your holiday memories!
